blocks.text: Dallas is in. Ten teams already are out. And 19 teams are jostling for seven remaining quarterfinal spots in the NBA Cup. Prepare for a wild Friday — with a lot of scoreboard watching. Group-stage play in the NBA’s in-season tournament ends Friday with 11 games — with 10 of them likely to play at least some role in deciding which teams advance to the knockout round that starts next week. The Mavericks are the only team that enters the final day of group play knowing that they’re heading to the quarterfinals; they have clinched the West Group A title. Tiebreakers […]...
